sources.title: Claude Mythos 5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact claude-mythos-5 entry: June 9, 2026 release; verification-required active service; 1M-token context; adaptive thinking always on; text/image input and text output. Current documentation, not an endpoint availability test.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: June 9 joint launch names Mythos 5 and Fable 5 as the same underlying model. Mythos access initially limited to Glasswing partners, with domain-specific safeguards lifted; biology access was planned. June 12 suspension and July 1 redeployment are later events.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: Full 319-page PDF fetched and text-extracted after web retrieval exceeded size limit. Page 11 explicitly states identical underlying weights with different safeguards/access. Pages 177 and 192 describe residual-stream steering across layers. No production parameter counts or explicit topology label located.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: September 1 later card fetched via official redirect to assets.claude.com/0339e6a7c5c7b87f5c07798616dc32c215d14235.pdf; 212 pages searched. Comparisons include Mythos 5, but no total/active production count disclosure located.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: Later first-party 230-page card fetched and text-searched for parameter counts and architecture. No Mythos 5 production count disclosure located; performance comparisons do not provide model sizes.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: October 2026 first-party 144-page card fetched and text-searched for production parameter counts and architecture. No Mythos 5 total or active count disclosure located.

sources.title: PDF support - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, implemented using vision. Exact Mythos 5 overview identifies it as active, supporting retention of PDF as a supported input format.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms govern API service use and retain underlying intellectual-property rights. Together with Mythos 5's verified restricted hosted distribution, supports descriptive proprietary licensing rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: An alignment assessment of recent cybersecurity incidents
sources.evidence: September 9 exact-model training/interpretability research discusses Mythos 5 activations, natural-language autoencoders, template lens, and training variants, but does not disclose production parameter counts or an explicit architecture label.

sources.title: Tool search tool - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Model compatibility explicitly lists claude-mythos-5 for both tool-search variants and describes the model selecting and calling discovered tools.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Mythos 5 summary
sources.evidence: Exact Mythos 5 section describes limited-partner defensive cybersecurity and biology access, June 2026 release, text/image inputs, and text-only output. Architecture/training section describes pretraining and post-training without specifying network topology.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

developer.note: First-party launch and card identify the developer.

family.note: Normalized catalog family follows official Mythos naming and succession from Mythos Preview.

release_date.note: Earliest announced release; later suspension/redeployment does not change this date.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: No production total count located in original or inspected later cards. Safeguard configurations share weights, but neither count is supplied.

active_parameters_b.note: No active production count located; cannot infer it from the total or interpretability features.

architecture.note: Exact-model material documents residual-stream activations and training, but does not establish a precise architecture classification or dense/MoE structure.

modalities.note: Native modalities are text/images to text; PDF is a supported API document input format.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking is always on for this exact model.

tool_call.note: Exact model listed in tool-search compatibility; documentation describes selecting and calling discovered tools.

description.value: Restricted Claude model for advanced cybersecurity and biology research workflows
description.note: Official exact-model documentation supports restricted cybersecurity/biology scope; general availability of Fable 5 does not transfer.

Anthropic statement on Claude weight availability

summary: Confirmed all asserted baseline fields using exact-model primary evidence; classify license as proprietary and replace catalog-only provenance. Total/active parameters and architecture remain null after original/later-card and exact-model research review. Fable 5 shares underlying weights explicitly, while Mythos 5 retains restricted access and different safeguards. No endpoint execution test was performed.
